name: com.redmadrobot.debug.core.ui.debugpanel.DebugBottomSheetActivity
description: When the app opens the RedMadRobot Debug Panel from its debug controls, this Activity displays the panel as a bottom sheet. The sheet can be dismissed to return to the app.
disableEffect: The RedMadRobot debug panel cannot be opened as a bottom sheet; ordinary app screens remain available.
